findings.description: A valid JSON array/null readiness response raises AttributeError and returns HTTP 500.
findings.evidence: Offline mocked /ai/test returned 500 for content []; expected controlled 502.
findings.root_cause: The readiness parser calls .get on JSON without checking object type; AttributeError is not handled.
findings.impact: Model/gateway faults become unhandled API errors.
findings.reproduction: Mock REST chat content as [] and POST /api/v1/workspace/ai/test with a valid session.
findings.recommended_fix: Require a JSON object and ready=true before consuming it.
findings.validation_plan: Malformed-object API regression and capacity-release assertion.

findings.description: Domain filtering drops explicit lifecycle resources whose properties omit domain.
findings.evidence: Requirement node without domain returns zero results in RM; UI infers RM from its type.
findings.root_cause: Backend falls back to CODE universally; materialized manifest resources lack domain. Managed requirement collections also default to CODE.
findings.impact: Incomplete domain searches, agent evidence and managed lifecycle views.
findings.reproduction: Search a manifest requirement without domain for Payment in RM.
findings.recommended_fix: Assign consistent type-based domains during materialization and managed enrichment; preserve provider overrides.

findings.description: UTF-8 BOM Python files silently fall back to generic extraction.
findings.evidence: Equivalent plain source yields class/function/variable; BOM source yields generic symbols.
findings.root_cause: ast.parse on a string rejects the leading BOM; the fallback suppresses typed extraction.
findings.impact: Valid Windows source loses typed classes, methods, variables and call analysis.
findings.reproduction: Analyze identical payment.py content with and without U+FEFF at the beginning.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove only a leading BOM for Python parsing, keeping raw source/digests intact.
findings.validation_plan: BOM/plain AST graph equivalence and managed folder regression.

findings.description: Non-numeric and out-of-range URL ports pass startup validation.
findings.root_cause: Validation checks hostname/scheme but never accesses the parsed port.
findings.impact: App starts with unusable integration configuration and fails later at runtime.
findings.reproduction: Validate either malformed endpoint through connection_url or a provider setting.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate the port and reject zero while keeping credential-redacted errors.
findings.validation_plan: Invalid port and valid implicit/explicit port tests.

findings.description: Bracketed IPv6 HOST accepted by Python generates an invalid frontend proxy.
findings.evidence: Offline Vite evaluation yields host=[::1], target=http://[[::1]]:8009.
findings.root_cause: Frontend wraps already bracketed host a second time and does not normalize the bind host.
findings.impact: Frontend/API communication fails for a supported configuration.
findings.reproduction: Resolve Vite config with HOST=[::1] and parse its proxy target.
findings.recommended_fix: Normalize one surrounding IPv6 bracket pair before bind/proxy construction.
findings.validation_plan: Execute Vite config with bare/bracketed IPv6 and verify valid target URLs.

findings.description: SQLite capacity teardown fails when dependency entry/exit execute on different threads.
findings.evidence: Deterministic cross-thread generator teardown raises AttributeError and leaves one renewing work lease.
findings.root_cause: Lease identity is stored only in threading.local; FastAPI yield teardown does not guarantee the same worker thread.
findings.impact: HTTP 500 and persistent capacity exhaustion in SQLite mode; subsequent requests receive 429.
findings.reproduction: Enter analysis_capacity on one worker and exit it on another using a temporary SQLite store.
findings.recommended_fix: Capture the acquired lease in the generator and pass it explicitly to release across threads.
findings.validation_plan: Cross-thread teardown, no lease rows, stopped renewal thread and SQLite direct-API concurrency regression.

findings.description: SQLite handles are not closed when initialization or BEGIN raises.
findings.evidence: Mock BEGIN lock failure: close called zero times in both adapters.
findings.root_cause: Setup executes before try/finally protecting connection closure.
findings.impact: Connections can linger after lock/I/O failures and delay recovery.
findings.reproduction: Inject sqlite3.OperationalError during BEGIN and inspect close calls.
findings.recommended_fix: Put setup and BEGIN inside unconditional close protection; preserve rollback and errors.
findings.validation_plan: Both stores close exactly once after setup failure and rollback after body failure.

findings.description: Locked Vitest 5.0.4 toolchain is affected by GHSA-p458-7748-mcp3.
findings.evidence: npm audit reports 3 moderate package records for one underlying advisory; fixed release is 5.0.5.
findings.root_cause: The lockfile predates the patched test server file-deny behavior.
findings.impact: Conditional developer-file/API-token exposure while affected test HTTP-server modes run; production bundle/plain vitest run not affected.
findings.reproduction: Run npm audit against the lock; compare the maintainer advisory affected range.
findings.validation_plan: Clean npm audit plus full frontend build/tests/lint.

findings.description: Core CLI without a subcommand raises AttributeError instead of showing help.
findings.evidence: python -m codegraph_core exits 1: Namespace has no attribute max_file_size.
findings.root_cause: Subcommand-only arguments are read before checking whether a subcommand was supplied.
findings.impact: The installed codegraph entry point fails its basic help/discovery workflow.
findings.reproduction: Run python -m codegraph_core with no arguments.
findings.recommended_fix: Print parser help and return before accessing subcommand arguments.
findings.validation_plan: Real subprocess exits 0 and prints usage without traceback.
